note.question: How do product reputation and advertising reach affect the ability of performance-based advertising to signal quality, and which attribution/payment rules preserve credible signaling?
note.overview: The core is a signaling game with privately known product quality. A high-quality firm must choose costly performance-based advertising that separates it from the low-quality type; consumers infer quality and buy over two periods. The paper derives separating sequential-equilibrium incentive constraints and studies alternative payment rules.

A high-quality firm must choose costly performance-based advertising that separates it from the low-quality type; consumers infer quality and buy over two periods.
